title: Debug Stick Flower Pot
description: Use a debug stick to change the item in your flower pot
body:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/_FjYy6RZGE8" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>


Unfortunately it is not possible to use the /give command to get a Flower Pot with a specific plant/flower in it. In this Plugin you first have to type `/give @s debug_stick` to get yourself a debug stick. With the debug stick you have the ability to change the plants in the flower pot. Use left-click to go through the different plants. Right-click to toggle between the empty pot and the flowers.
